title.narrative: Improved national social protection and care system providing inclusive, integrated, life- cycle support, risk informed, resilient and gender responsive approaches focusing on the needs of the vulnerable

description.narrative: Despite notable advancements in Viet Nam's social protection framework, a significant disparity persists between current social insurance coverage and the ambitious 2030 target. To bridge this divide, the International Labour Organization (ILO) is actively collaborating with Viet Nam's tripartite partners—government, employers, and workers—to foster a more inclusive and resilient social protection system. This collaborative effort focuses on extending coverage to the widest possible demographic, ensuring that no segment of the population is left behind. The ILO's support encompasses equipping Vietnamese stakeholders with the necessary tools and expertise to spearhead impactful policy reforms. This includes raising awareness about international social protection standards and best practices among key actors, such as policymakers, workers, and employers. Furthermore, the ILO facilitates evidence-based decision-making by policymakers and technical experts, aligning national policies with both domestic development objectives and international commitments. Beyond policy reform, the ILO aims to amplify public discourse on the pivotal role of social protection in bolstering economic resilience, fostering human capital development, and ensuring social stability.
